title: Imp Jar Select Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Imp Jar Select Banana Ice is a smooth and creamy fruit blend. It recreates the rich, authentic taste of ripe Bananas, perfectly paired with a crisp, icy Menthol note on the exhale. This combination delivers a satisfyingly sweet and frosty vape that is smooth from start to finish. The Imp Jar Select nic salt range utilise twice as much flavour concentrate as standard e-liquids for an intense flavour payoff which pairs perfectly with starter kits and refillable pod kits. Launched in conjunction with Imp Jar's first pod vape kit, the Imp Jar Select, Imp Jar Select Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
